steps.message: How many mountain biking activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.

Execute: adb shell "date; echo '---'; ls -la /data/data | grep -i -E 'opentracks|open.tracks|track' || true; echo '---'; ls -la /data/user/0 | grep -i -E 'opentracks|open.tracks|track' || true; echo '---'; ls -la /data/user/0/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la /data/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la /data/user/0/de.tadris.fitness/databases 2>/dev/null || true"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; echo '---'; ls -la /data/data | grep -i -E 'opentracks|open.tracks|track' || true; echo '---'; ls -la /data/user/0 | grep -i -E 'opentracks|open.tracks|track' || true; echo '---'; ls -la /data/user/0/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la /data/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks/databases 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la /data/user/0/de.tadris.fitness/databases 2>/dev/null || true""
